note: Dimmit County publishes no zoning districts layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The only zoning in the county is the City of Carrizo Springs zoning map, published as a 29 MB PDF map (viewer-only, no queryable polygons). The Dimmit CAD ArcGIS service has parcels, city limits and boundaries but no zoning layer. No other city in the county was found publishing zoning.
